## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- EstimateEngine.create — line/subtotal/total reconciliation
- computes line extensions and subtotal; no discount/tax → grandTotal == subtotal
- rounds a line extension to the cent (3 × $33.33 = $99.99)
- default validity is 30 days from issue date
- honors a custom validDays
- EstimateEngine.create — fallback estimateId uniqueness (P2 silent-collision fix)
